description: Use this when the user asks what AI assistants say about a specific business, or whether AI tools mention or recommend it. Given the business's public website, it reads the site (robots.txt, the homepage and up to 2 contact, booking or pricing pages), writes 3 typical customer questions, and asks 3 AI models each question, answering from what they already know (no web search). It reports, for each model, whether it named the business and where it ranked when it gave a list, up to 2 statements where an AI model contradicts the website, and a one-line crawler summary. Input: one public website and, optionally, the business name. A result for the same website may come from a check run in the last 24 hours. Changes nothing on the site.

business_name.description: The business's name, if the website doesn't make it obvious.

city.description: The city the business serves, if the website doesn't say.

website.description: The public website to check, like example.com or https://www.example.com. One site per call.

name: quick_ai_visibility_check

cached.description: True when this is a recent check's result, served again

contradictions.description: Statements where an AI model contradicts the website

position.description: Its best position when the model gave a list (1 = first)

title: Quick AI visibility check
